title.zh: 本法案规定在Olongapo市辖区内新设立名为New Kabalan的行政村
title.en: An Act Creating the Barrio of New Kabalan in Olongapo City
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrio of New Kabalan in Olongapo City
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Barrio New Kabalan tại Thành phố Olongapo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งบาริโอ New Kabalan ในเมือง Olongapo
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Barrio New Kabalan di Kota Olongapo
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Barrio New Kabalan di Bandar Olongapo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6180_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of New Kabalan in the barrio of Sta. Rita, Olongapo City, is hereby separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said city, to be known as the barrio of New Kabalan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
